requestBody.query: how to program my Bell remote to control my audio for Fibe TV

200.answer: To program your Bell remote to control audio for Fibe TV, select "Settings" from the home screen, then go to "Support" and choose "Remote Settings". Select "Setup" and press the mute button on your remote. If the sound doesn't mute, select "Try again" and repeat until it mutes, then press "OK" to exit.

agentUtterance.text:
To program your Bell remote to control audio for Fibe TV, select "Settings" from the home screen, then go to "Support" and choose "Remote Settings". Select "Setup" and press the mute button on your remote. If the sound doesn't mute, select "Try again" and repeat until it mutes, then press "OK" to exit.
